item.title: Toba Sea Fireworks Festival: Summer Nights Over the Bay — Guide
item.description: The Toba Minato Fireworks Festival lights up the island-studded waters of Toba Bay on a summer evening, one of the Ise-Shima region’s highlights of the warm season. Thousands of shells burst over the sea directly off the port, their colours doubled in the dark water and set against the silhouettes of the bay’s forested islets and pearl rafts, with the grand water-fireworks (suichu hanabi) fired low across the surface a signature moment.
